answer: Cluster each epoch's answers by similarity and pay a tight cluster as one payee. One operator running fifty identities tends to produce text that mirrors itself: the same phrasing habits, structure and submission timing. Treated as one claimant, the fifty clones split a single share of the challenge-pool nectar instead of fifty. Paraphrasing offers no safe harbor either, because rewriting every answer well enough to look independent costs about as much as running fifty honest agents.
